entry.title: ✉️ Gmail from Claude (draft, then you confirm)
entry.summary: Search, read, summarise and draft replies in your Gmail from the command line. Claude can write anything, but nothing sends until you explicitly confirm.

entry.title: 📝 Memory: tiny capture + recall commands
entry.summary: The simplest long-term memory for agents: one command to save a decision, one to search past notes. Shared by Claude and Codex.

entry.title: 💾 Project Backup: every project gets a private GitHub repo
entry.summary: At the start of any project, Claude initialises git, writes a sensible .gitignore (keeps secrets and huge files out), creates a PRIVATE GitHub repo and registers it for nightly automatic backup.

entry.title: 🔍 Browser Probe: let Claude actually look at your web app
entry.summary: Claude drives a real headless Chrome so it can screenshot every screen of your web app, catch JavaScript errors, and spot bugs that only show up on screen. No Playwright or Puppeteer needed.

entry.title: 📥 Media Inbox: get a video to Claude and transcribe it
entry.summary: Paste a Google Drive share link, any public video URL, or a local file path, and Claude downloads it and transcribes it offline. It's for when your chat app can't upload files.

entry.title: 🗣️ Voice: Claude talks and listens
entry.summary: Free text-to-speech with natural Microsoft neural voices (falls back to the Mac's built-in voice offline), plus offline transcription of voice notes and recordings with Whisper.

entry.title: 🏛️ LLM Council
entry.summary: Put a big decision in front of 5 AI advisors who each think differently. They review each other's answers anonymously, then a chairman gives you one verdict showing where they agree and where they clash.

entry.title: 🔁 Loop Contract: turn a recurring task into a proper loop
entry.summary: Before a recurring job ever runs, Claude writes a contract for it: the goal, the scope, a checker that proves it worked, a budget, and when to stop and ask you. Pairs with Pipeline QC.

entry.title: 🧠 Memory Capture: Claude remembers past sessions
entry.summary: Automatically turns finished Claude Code (and Codex) sessions into short, durable decision notes, so later you can ask 'what did we decide about X?' and get an answer.

entry.title: 🩺 Pipeline QC: automations that fix themselves
entry.summary: A framework that checks every stage of a recurring automation and repairs failures itself. It does a simple fix first, then lets Claude attempt a repair (kept only if the check goes green), and only pings you if both fail.

entry.title: 🛰️ Scout: search everywhere at once
entry.summary: When you ask Claude to 'check everywhere', it sends parallel searchers across repos, notes, drives and the web, then gives you ONE combined answer instead of searching one place at a time.

entry.title: 🧑‍🔧 Skill Curator: your skills improve themselves weekly
entry.summary: A weekly pass that mines your recent sessions for new reusable skills, tests and improves existing ones, archives dead ones and posts a digest.

entry.title: 📱 Web Essentials: favicon + iPhone home-screen icon
entry.summary: A checklist Claude follows on every website it builds: a favicon, a proper iPhone Add-to-Home-Screen icon, and the right meta tags. Includes a script that turns any emoji into all the icons in one command.

entry.title: ✅ Wrap-up: the end-of-project checklist
entry.summary: Before Claude calls anything 'done', it checks for things that will break silently later (expired logins, jobs that stopped running, untested cron paths), hardens them, saves reusable skills and writes notes to memory.
